description: This is a test class for the BuzzAnniversaryDao component within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing methods related to upcoming employee anniversaries. It uses PHPUnit and contains setup methods as well as two test cases for counting and listing upcoming anniversaries.

classes.name: BuzzAnniversaryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzAnniversaryDao's functionalities related to employee anniversaries in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and the actual DAO instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetUpcomingAnniversariesList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of upcoming employee anniversaries list within a specified date range and year.

methods.name: testGetUpcomingAnniversariesCount
methods.description: Tests the count of upcoming employee anniversaries based on the set filter parameters.
